$comment: Repo Governor governing its own repository. Canonical format is JSON (ADR-015). This file is the sole artifact that binds providers to roles (ADR-004); a provider absent here has no governance role, however reachable it is (INV-013).

condition.$comment: L1: one package, small dependency surface, one maintainer. Not L0 — architecture history exists. No floor indicator present: no public API, no release branches, no generated consumers.

roadmap_authority.$comment: Bound to the file provider, which carries explicit authority values and needs no admission convention. Recorded because ADR-018 surfaced a real ambiguity: this repository has BOTH Project #5 and milestone RG-SIM-ONBOARDING-v0.1, and nothing previously forced a statement of which governs. If the binding ever moves to adapters/github-projects, it must declare admission.signal explicitly.

decision_history.$comment: ADR-019. Dolt supplies the evidence chain natively (dolt_log, dolt_history_decisions), so ADR-009's hand-specified hash chaining is superseded rather than reimplemented.

Second backend. GitHub already records decisions in stateReason and nothing was reading them. Bound alongside Dolt because decision_history is multi-valued (ADR-013); disagreement is CONFLICT, not precedence.

permissions.$comment: Deny by default (ADR-005). Read-only throughout: Repo Governor rules, it does not act.

decision_history.$comment: The only write granted anywhere in this manifest. ADR-005 rule 4 treats write as exceptional and read as presumed; this is the exception, because the engine recording its own decisions is what makes INV-005 enforceable. Every other role stays read-only.
